offers_products.reason: Sells test and measurement instruments, gas detection devices, sterilization equipment and consumables, and software (Fluke, Accruent, ASP, Gordian).

offers_services.reason: Offers calibration, repair, and maintenance services plus SaaS-linked services, but these are secondary to instruments and software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are hospitals, industrial firms, construction and facilities operators; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to hospitals, laboratories, industrial companies, building owners and distributors reselling Fluke tools.

recurring_revenue.reason: Substantial software subscriptions, sterilization consumables, and service contracts drive repeat revenue, though tool sales are transactional.

cyclical_demand.reason: Safety, compliance, infection prevention and maintenance demand is fairly resilient, though industrial tool purchases can soften.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are handheld tools, consumables and software subscriptions, which are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from instruments, consumables and software, not from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mixed: hospitals, industrial and facility firms, and many small contractors buying through distributors.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light technology and instrument maker with outsourced and modest manufacturing; growth comes from software and acquisitions.

notes: Large-customer and recurring-revenue answers are judgment calls given a mixed portfolio.
